// Package wfextract holds the Yaegi symbol table for internal/workflow,
// generated by `go generate`. Kept separate from internal/workflow itself
// so the generated file can import it without a self-import cycle.
package wfextract

import "reflect"

//go:generate go run github.com/traefik/yaegi/cmd/yaegi extract -name wfextract github.com/samcharles93/archie-core/internal/workflow

var Symbols = map[string]map[string]reflect.Value{}
